description: Defines the DeactivationReason struct, representing reasons for grain deactivation in Orleans, including properties for code, description, and exception, with various constructors and a ToString() override.

classes.name: DeactivationReason
classes.description: Immutable struct representing a reason for grain deactivation, including reason code, descriptive text, and optional exception.

properties.name: Exception
properties.description: Optional exception that led to deactivation.

constructors.name: DeactivationReason
constructors.description: Initializes with reason code and descriptive text, null exception.

constructors.name: DeactivationReason
constructors.description: Initializes with reason code, associated exception, and descriptive text.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation including reason code, description, and exception if any.
